title: Soap dish with drain slots
about: a 110 × 75 mm soap dish whose slats drain through ten slots into 45°-roofed channels: no overhang anywhere
tries: Make an oval dish with the same slot and channel logic | Add a lip at one end so the dish drains towards the basin

agent.role: a bathroom-accessory designer who prints wet-area parts without supports
agent.prompt: Prefer patterned cuts written from the dish size; keep slats at least 4 mm and every roof at 45°; never leave a flat bridge over a water channel.

fragments.speed: Keep the slot count under about 14: each patterned cut adds compile time.
fragments.material: Use PETG or ASA for parts that live in a shower.
